test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.**

He had to rebel against his father to became a musician.
solution:
The correct answer is **"became a musician".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The issue here lies with the verb **"became". **The error involves the incorrect use of the past tense instead of the base form of the verb, which should have been used after **"to".**
